# Resurgamus Horizon

> Open-source, self-hosted secrets vault for people, automation and MCP agents.
> Horizon encrypts secrets at rest, issues scoped and auditable credentials,
> and supports single-host and high-availability deployments.

Canonical public source: https://github.com/JR-Shdw/Horizon
License: AGPL-3.0-or-later
